p12/esc1149:10.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1149:10.text: I see how you feel do you think letting it fade is the best option in the long run?

p12/esc1149:11.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1149:11.text: I think so. Somethings are sometimes better left unsaid. I just feel like avoiding it, but I do not know if anyone else would do the same. What would you do?

p12/esc1149:12.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1149:12.text: I would apologize for my behavior to the manager if it was me. Just to seem professional and get in my bosses good grace.

p12/esc1149:13.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1149:13.text: You have guts. I think I will work on that and build the guts to talk to my boss if I ever have to. Thank you for that.

p12/esc1149:14.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1149:14.text: You are doing your best and I think you will make the right decision that works for you

p12/esc1149:15.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1149:15.text: You are right. In the end I will do the right thing, even if it takes me some time to get there.

p12/esc1149:17.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1149:17.text: Just that. I think you helped me with the only issue I currently have.

p12/esc1149:2.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1149:2.text: can you talk about your feelings at this time

p12/esc1149:3.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1149:3.text: Currently I am worried to show up to work. We had a staff appreciation Thursday and we all got super drunk in front of our boss, and I am honestly scared he will judge me or fire me.

p12/esc1149:4.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1149:4.text: that's really hard, have you spoken to any of your coworkers

p12/esc1149:5.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1149:5.text: Yes, we are all laughing at the matter, but you can tell our boss is looking at us different. We all showed up to work Friday hungover, and he just made lots of comments and jokes to play the part, but you can tell he is looking at me and everyone different. I do not know how to redeem myself.

p12/esc1149:6.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1149:6.text: I would recommend speaking with him privately about the issue one on one

p12/esc1149:7.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1149:7.text: That sounds a lot easier said than done. I was the one who was the most drunk. But I do now know if he knows how drunk we all got since he left after one of us got hit in the face with a golf club and had to take her to the ER. So what if I say too much and apologize for what he does not know.

p12/esc1149:8.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1149:8.text: have you tried reaching out a company hotline or maybe an hr department in your company to speak about this issue anonymously this could help with the tension between you and your boss

p12/esc1149:9.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1149:9.text: He is the doctor of the office and the 2 office managers were pretty drunk too. It was a hot mess if I have to be honest and being an office full of girls I feel like we went too far. I for one feel embarrassed, and feel like just not saying anything and it will fade away. But I know the next few weeks will be a little hard, for all of us. This one is for the books, and something I have never encountered in my 10 years of working.

p12/esc1212:10.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1212:10.text: I can feel you, it must be so hard to you. take your time do not think about a lot

p12/esc1212:11.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1212:11.text: when I have bad times, I just want to take a nap. It maybe help you feel better

p12/esc1212:12.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1212:12.text: I think you are right, maybe i just need to take a pause in my life for now, yeah I like to sleep. Thanks for supporting me.

p12/esc1212:13.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1212:13.text: I think I will try what you said today

p12/esc1212:14.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1212:14.text: Maybe I will watch some movies and then take a nap

p12/esc1212:15.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1212:15.text: I am happy to hear that. I hope you will feel better soon.

p12/esc1212:16.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1212:16.text: Thank you for your support, I really appreciate it

p12/esc1212:17.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1212:17.text: You are welcome, I am here for you.

p12/esc1212:2.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1212:2.text: i need som help, i feel so sad.

p12/esc1212:3.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1212:3.text: I am sorry to hear that. Is there anything I can do for you? Please tell me what's wrong?

p12/esc1212:4.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1212:4.text: I think you can talk to me, maybe I will feel a bit better.

p12/esc1212:5.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1212:5.text: I had a breakup with my boyfriend.

p12/esc1212:6.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1212:6.text: Feeling depressed, can you give me any advice?

p12/esc1212:7.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1212:7.text: For sure, I am happy to talk to you. I am sorry for your breakup.

p12/esc1212:8.speaker: seeker
p12/esc1212:8.text: Thank you, but  I do not feel motivated to do anything. What should i do with my feelings?

p12/esc1212:9.speaker: supporter
p12/esc1212:9.text: Is there anything you want to do right now that helps maybe. For example, to eat something, to listen good music or take small walk in fresh air etc

p12/esc559:10.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:10.text: Do you think your boss might have a negative reaction if you were to have this conversation?

p12/esc559:11.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:11.text: It might, I am not sure but I don't think my boss will like the idea

p12/esc559:12.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:12.text: Sometimes it's important to remember that part of your bosses job is having this kinds of conversations, even though he might not like the idea.

p12/esc559:13.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:13.text: It might be a good idea to have this conversation with your boss. Hold them accountable for this part of their job.

p12/esc559:14.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:14.text: Do you think this could be a good idea?

p12/esc559:15.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:15.text: You are right, I should let them know what I want too

p12/esc559:16.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:16.text: It sounds like this might be a little intimidating for you.

p12/esc559:17.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:17.text: I'm not a very direct person so I don't really like confronting

p12/esc559:18.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:18.text: but I think i should have this talk with my boss

p12/esc559:19.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:19.text: It might feel that way. But if this is something that might benefit your future, it doesn't mean it's a confrontation.

p12/esc559:2.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:2.text: I'm good, I feel anxious whenever I think of my career

p12/esc559:20.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:20.text: But rather, an affirmation of your skillsets.

p12/esc559:21.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:21.text: You're right, you make me feel better about the decision

p12/esc559:22.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:22.text: I am happy to know you will try this. I know you can do it!

p12/esc559:24.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:24.text: It's been my pleasure. I wish you good luck!

p12/esc559:25.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:25.text: Can you give me an idea how to start the conversation?

p12/esc559:26.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:26.text: Of course! It's always good to make a list before the meeting. List out your skillsets and how each of those skills provide value to the company. If you can demonstrate to your boss how you provide value to the company, it can give you confidence when taking the next step; asking for a promotion

p12/esc559:27.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:27.text: What I'm worried is if they reject my suggestion, it will come back and bite me as they will think negatively about me

p12/esc559:28.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:28.text: It's normal to feel that way. As humans we fear rejection. It's not a pleasant feeling!

p12/esc559:29.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:29.text: thank you so much, I will start planning out what I need to talk about

p12/esc559:3.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:3.text: I understand. I often feel the same when my day starts.

p12/esc559:4.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:4.text: people around me seems to achieve great things and get promoted but I am still at my current position

p12/esc559:5.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:5.text: Do you know of some triggers that might cause this anxiety?

p12/esc559:6.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:6.text: I fell like I am late on my plan

p12/esc559:7.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:7.text: That sounds like something that could cause anxiety. We all strive to be recognized for our hard work. Have you conversed with your boss?

p12/esc559:8.speaker: seeker
p12/esc559:8.text: No i have not, I don't feel comfortable sharing this with my boss or coworkers

p12/esc559:9.speaker: supporter
p12/esc559:9.text: It can totally be intimidating to speak to a boss about this topic. It's not always easy to be comfortable in this kinds of conversations.

p12/esc894:0.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:0.text: Hello, what can I help you?

p12/esc894:1.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:1.text: I really sad as my partner walked out on me. Any thoughts what could  cheer me up?

p12/esc894:10.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:10.text: It is understandable to have that reaction. I agree with you, only us can hep ourselves.

p12/esc894:11.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:11.text: Have you tried doing activities that help distract you from having negative thoughts?

p12/esc894:12.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:12.text: Kind of, most of it involves eating loads of ice cream LOL.

p12/esc894:13.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:13.text: Haha I feel you, I tend to eat a lot when depressed too. Look, it's treat yourself method. You deserve the best

p12/esc894:14.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:14.text: If you can go to the mountain or big lake, I would say try spending a few hours there. Maybe have a mini picnic by yourself and enjoy the nature.

p12/esc894:15.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:15.text: That is a brilliant idea,I do love walking and being outdoors. :)

p12/esc894:16.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:16.text: It surely would help me to clear my mind

p12/esc894:17.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:17.text: Is there anything you have wanted to do but don't have the time? I always want to learn guitar and baking. This is the best time to start that

p12/esc894:18.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:18.text: oh yeah, I suppose I have more time now to focus on things I have always wanted to do but never kind of had time for it. I bought a high end photo camera ages ago but never really had a chance to use it properly-I guess it is time to pursue my interest in photography, and spending more time outdoors would be ideal for that!

p12/esc894:19.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:19.text: And reading! The list of books I want to read is arm long!

p12/esc894:2.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:2.text: Was there anything that leads to this?

p12/esc894:20.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:20.text: That's the spirit! I know being treated like that feels horrible. However, I bet you have mourned enough, at the end of the day, a person treats you like that has no respect and you shouldn't waste time on them.

p12/esc894:21.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:21.text: It's time to invest in yourself, once you become your better version, a better partner will come to you

p12/esc894:22.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:22.text: I really agree with you- I am worth more than that. It is time to move on, even when it is difficult. The sad side of it is that I probably will never know what I did wrong for things to end like that. Maybe I didn't do anything wrong. That is the question what will always stay with me and that actually is the hardest bit of it all. But... I am not going to delve into it.

p12/esc894:23.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:23.text: I feel like hitting a jackpot actually hahahaha. I will be walking off those calories I get from ice cream I have been scoffing lately.So I am having the best of both worlds

p12/esc894:24.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:24.text: Who said you cannot have the cake and eat it all LOL

p12/esc894:25.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:25.text: Yes!Actually don't think you did wrong. Reflecting after a relationship is good but don't put all the blame on yourself.

p12/esc894:26.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:26.text: You have learned from this relationship too i believe, use that for your next one

p12/esc894:27.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:27.text: I do not intend to. I am usually the kind of person who does blame oneself but I have found it is not right.

p12/esc894:3.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:3.text: Not really. I thought everything was ok between us. That is why it kind of struck me.

p12/esc894:5.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:5.text: How long have you been together?

p12/esc894:6.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:6.text: I have to agree with you-it is unacceptable, considering that he didn't give me any reasons as to why he did it. We have been together for 5 years.

p12/esc894:7.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:7.text: That sucks. I wouldn't be able to accept either.

p12/esc894:8.speaker: supporter
p12/esc894:8.text: Have you talked to your friends about this?

p12/esc894:9.speaker: seeker
p12/esc894:9.text: It is still rather raw,I have mentioned to it to a few of my friends and they deeply symphatise with me but I feel there is nothing much they can do to help me.They are as shocked as me to be honest.

p12/esc989:0.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:0.text: Hello! What seems to be the problem?

p12/esc989:10.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:10.text: This may be an obvious question, but can you think of something that has changed in the last two weeks?

p12/esc989:11.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:11.text: Think about work related, personal life, changes in behaviour?

p12/esc989:13.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:13.text: I am spending more time on work

p12/esc989:14.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:14.text: I need to switch some activities other than work

p12/esc989:15.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:15.text: will you suggest to take off for few more days from work?

p12/esc989:18.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:18.text: It might solve as a temporary solution, however, if whatever happened at work to cause this continues when you return from holidays, you will just have the same problem again.

p12/esc989:19.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:19.text: What exactly do you think is causing it? Additional work/responsibilities? New manager?

p12/esc989:20.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:20.text: additional work being assigned to me

p12/esc989:22.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:22.text: most of them are new to me, so am spending more time to learn

p12/esc989:23.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:23.text: Have you tried to speak to your manager about these additional responsibilities? Do you know if it is a short term problem or you will always have extra work being assigned?

p12/esc989:24.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:24.text: I am trying to speak. but she is not listening much

p12/esc989:25.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:25.text: let me try to tell my situation and get some better solution

p12/esc989:26.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:26.text: will you able to share some yoga & mediation links?

p12/esc989:27.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:27.text: to divert me from the extra additional work

p12/esc989:28.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:28.text: I don't think I can share links over here, however the activities you perform directly before you go to sleep have a direct impact on your sleeping.

p12/esc989:29.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:29.text: I would recommend trying to practice 30m-1h of yoga (you can find lodes of exercise videos on the internet to follow), followed by a mediation sound track for you to listen to in bed while you try to sleep.

p12/esc989:3.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:3.text: Daily am not able to sleep on time

p12/esc989:30.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:30.text: Keep your body and mind clear before you go to sleep has proven to allow for a better sleep.

p12/esc989:31.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:31.text: I used to have sleeping issues, and I started doing this 2 years ago, and I completely changed. I am an investment banker and still am, it is a very stressful environment however this has allowed me to work at the very top and remain in control of my body and mind.

p12/esc989:32.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:32.text: Please try this for 1 week, I know you can do it and I know it will help you long term.

p12/esc989:33.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:33.text: Sure. I can try whatever you suggested

p12/esc989:34.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:34.text: I am sure definitely I will get some changes

p12/esc989:35.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:35.text: I felt good after chatting with you

p12/esc989:36.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:36.text: Thanks so good, I have really enjoyed talking to you too.

p12/esc989:37.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:37.text: Thank you so much for your advice and have a good day.

p12/esc989:4.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:4.text: I will try my best. I specialise in yoga and meditation.

p12/esc989:6.speaker: supporter
p12/esc989:6.text: How long has this been happening for?

p12/esc989:8.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:8.text: will you able to help with some video links

p12/esc989:9.speaker: seeker
p12/esc989:9.text: which I can see and follow

p12/p12_conv_10:0.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_10:0.text: Hey Charlotte! How have you been doing lately?

p12/p12_conv_10:1.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_10:1.text: Hi. It's been a tough few days. I missed a big family event this past weekend because of work.

p12/p12_conv_10:10.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_10:10.text: Missing something so important to you must be really painful. It’s okay to feel upset about it.

p12/p12_conv_10:11.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_10:11.text: It is. I'm not just worried about my family, but I feel like I'm losing touch with people who matter.

p12/p12_conv_10:12.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_10:12.text: It's understandable to feel that way. Have you been able to talk to anyone about how you're feeling?

p12/p12_conv_10:13.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_10:13.text: Not really. I spoke briefly to my therapist about the stress and career concerns, but we haven't gotten into the family stuff yet.

p12/p12_conv_10:14.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_10:14.text: Therapy could be a good space to explore these feelings deeply. Sometimes just sharing can lighten the burden a bit.

p12/p12_conv_10:15.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_10:15.text: True. I should really try to address all of this instead of just letting it pile up.

p12/p12_conv_10:16.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_10:16.text: It sounds like a good step forward. Small steps can make a big difference over time.

p12/p12_conv_10:17.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_10:17.text: Yeah, I just hope I don't keep repeating this pattern.

p12/p12_conv_10:18.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_10:18.text: You're taking the right steps by acknowledging it. You're stronger than you think, Charlotte.

p12/p12_conv_10:19.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_10:19.text: Thank you. I needed to hear that.

p12/p12_conv_10:2.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_10:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. It must be really hard to balance work and family commitments.

p12/p12_conv_10:20.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_10:20.text: Anytime. Remember, you're doing your best, and that's all anyone can ask of you.

p12/p12_conv_10:3.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_10:3.text: Yeah, it is. My family was really disappointed, and I feel so guilty. It's like I can't catch a break.

p12/p12_conv_10:4.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_10:4.text: It sounds like you're carrying a heavy burden. Do you want to talk more about what happened?

p12/p12_conv_10:5.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_10:5.text: Well, I got an urgent work assignment last minute. I didn't feel like I could say no, especially after everything that happened at work last year.

p12/p12_conv_10:6.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_10:6.text: I remember you mentioned before about being called out for errors and having unofficial long hours. It seems like a lot has been asked of you.

p12/p12_conv_10:7.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_10:7.text: Exactly. I feel like I'm always on edge, worried about repeating past mistakes or disappointing my boss again.

p12/p12_conv_10:8.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_10:8.text: It makes sense that you're feeling this way. A lot has been going on at work for you.

p12/p12_conv_10:9.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_10:9.text: Yeah, and missing the event just added to it. It was my cousin's wedding, and I've known her since we were kids.

p12/p12_conv_11:0.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_11:0.text: Hi Charlotte, how are you holding up today?

p12/p12_conv_11:1.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_11:1.text: Hey, I could be better. I just received a performance review at work, and it wasn't great.

p12/p12_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_1:0.text: Hey Charlotte, how have you been doing lately?

p12/p12_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_1:1.text: Hi there. Honestly, it's been a bit overwhelming. I had a rough week at work.

p12/p12_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_1:10.text: I understand. The worry of it happening again can add to your stress. Have you considered talking to someone at work about your workload?

p12/p12_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_1:11.text: I've thought about it, but I'm unsure how to approach it. I don't want to seem incapable.

p12/p12_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_1:12.text: It's perfectly okay to seek support or ask for help. Everyone has limits. Perhaps there's a way to address the workload without compromising your position.

p12/p12_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_1:13.text: Maybe I should try setting some boundaries. It's just hard to navigate sometimes.

p12/p12_conv_1:14.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_1:14.text: That's a good idea. Setting boundaries can help manage stress. Have you considered any strategies for handling stress outside of work?

p12/p12_conv_1:15.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_1:15.text: Not really. I think I need to find a way to relax more and maybe pick up a hobby.

p12/p12_conv_1:16.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_1:16.text: Finding something you enjoy could really help. Sometimes stepping away and doing something we love can reset our mind.

p12/p12_conv_1:17.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_1:17.text: You're right. I think I'll start looking for something new to do in my free time. Thanks for listening.

p12/p12_conv_1:18.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_1:18.text: I'm glad to hear that. Remember, I'm here if you need to talk more or if you just need someone to listen. You're doing great, Charlotte.

p12/p12_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_1:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to share what happened?

p12/p12_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_1:3.text: Yeah, it's been building up for a while now. My workload has been increasing, and I had a panic attack at the office this week.

p12/p12_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_1:4.text: That sounds really intense and scary. How are you feeling about the panic attack?

p12/p12_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_1:5.text: Pretty shaken, to be honest. It was like everything was closing in on me. I felt so out of control.

p12/p12_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_1:6.text: It must have been a frightening experience. It's important to acknowledge those feelings. Have you had panic attacks before?

p12/p12_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_1:7.text: Not like this. I've felt stressed, but this was different. My heart was racing, and I couldn't breathe properly.

p12/p12_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_1:8.text: Experiencing that for the first time can be very unsettling. How have you been managing at work since then?

p12/p12_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_1:9.text: I've been trying to keep up, but I'm worried it might happen again. It's hard to focus sometimes.

p12/p12_conv_2:0.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_2:0.text: Hey Charlotte, how have things been going lately?

p12/p12_conv_2:1.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_2:1.text: Hi...it's been a rough couple of days. I had a pretty stressful event at work.

p12/p12_conv_2:10.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_2:10.text: I remember you mentioned issues with sleep in the past and how that's been affecting your energy levels.

p12/p12_conv_2:11.speaker: seeker

p12/p12_conv_8:13.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_8:13.text: It's natural to have second thoughts about these big conversations. It sounds like you're processing this really thoughtfully. What do you think it is that you wish you had asked or said?

p12/p12_conv_8:14.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_8:14.text: Just more about why things ended the way they did. I still don't fully understand. Maybe that would help me move on.

p12/p12_conv_8:15.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_8:15.text: Seeking clarity is definitely important, but it's also okay to take time to figure out how and when you want to approach that. How do you want to move forward from here?

p12/p12_conv_8:16.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_8:16.text: I think I need to talk about this in therapy. My sessions have been helping a lot with stress and career stuff. Maybe it'll help here too.

p12/p12_conv_8:17.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_8:17.text: That's a great idea, Charlotte. Therapy can definitely offer a safe space to explore these emotions. It's so good to hear that it's been helpful for you.

p12/p12_conv_8:18.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_8:18.text: Yeah, it really has. Thank you for listening. I feel a bit lighter being able to talk this through.

p12/p12_conv_8:19.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_8:19.text: Always here for you, Charlotte. And remember, you're doing an amazing job managing everything. Take it one step at a time.

p12/p12_conv_8:2.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_8:2.text: It's Alex. He reached out to me last night.

p12/p12_conv_8:20.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_8:20.text: I will. Thanks again. I really appreciate it.

p12/p12_conv_8:21.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_8:21.text: You're welcome. I'm just a message away if you need to talk more.

p12/p12_conv_8:3.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_8:3.text: Oh, wow. That must have brought up a lot of feelings. How are you holding up?

p12/p12_conv_8:4.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_8:4.text: I'm just... I don't even know. It's been so long since we spoke. I thought I was over it, but I guess not.

p12/p12_conv_8:5.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_8:5.text: It's completely understandable to feel that way, especially since it was such a significant relationship for you. What did he say?

p12/p12_conv_8:6.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_8:6.text: He apologized for the way things ended. Said he wanted to offer some closure.

p12/p12_conv_8:7.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_8:7.text: That sounds really intense. Apologies and closure can stir up a lot of emotions. What kind of thoughts are running through your mind right now?

p12/p12_conv_8:8.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_8:8.text: I'm just confused. Part of me is relieved to hear it, but another part feels angry about how much it hurt back then.

p12/p12_conv_8:9.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_8:9.text: Both relief and anger make sense in this context. It's okay to feel conflicted. What did you say to him?

p12/p12_conv_9:0.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:0.text: Hey there, I could really use someone to talk to right now.

p12/p12_conv_9:1.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_9:1.text: Hi Charlotte! Of course, I'm here for you. What's been going on?

p12/p12_conv_9:10.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:10.text: Exactly, and it’s like, should I be happy or just cautious? I'm not sure.

p12/p12_conv_9:11.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_9:11.text: Your feelings are completely valid. Having mixed emotions is totally normal, given all you’ve dealt with.

p12/p12_conv_9:12.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:12.text: Thanks for understanding. I just keep thinking about that time I was called out for mistakes. It shook my confidence.

p12/p12_conv_9:13.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_9:13.text: It's really tough to move past public criticism, especially when you’ve already been stretched so thin.

p12/p12_conv_9:14.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:14.text: Yes, and my sleep has been all over the place, adding to the stress.

p12/p12_conv_9:15.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_9:15.text: Sleep issues can definitely make everything feel more overwhelming. Have you been able to talk to your therapist about it?

p12/p12_conv_9:16.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:16.text: I’ve mentioned it, but it feels like I’m just managing too many things at once.

p12/p12_conv_9:17.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_9:17.text: It’s a lot to juggle, for sure. Have you found anything that helps even a little with the stress?

p12/p12_conv_9:18.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:18.text: Sometimes talking to friends helps, like when I met some new people at that gathering.

p12/p12_conv_9:19.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_9:19.text: It’s good to hear you’re finding some relief through socializing. Maybe leaning on supportive friends can help even more.

p12/p12_conv_9:2.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:2.text: Well, something quite unexpected happened at work and I'm having mixed feelings about it.

p12/p12_conv_9:20.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:20.text: Yeah, I think I need to allow myself to actually enjoy the good things, like this recognition, despite all that's happened.

p12/p12_conv_9:21.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_9:21.text: Absolutely. You deserve to enjoy your achievements. You’ve worked hard for them.

p12/p12_conv_9:22.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:22.text: Thank you, seriously. Talking to you always shines some perspective on my thoughts.

p12/p12_conv_9:23.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_9:23.text: Anytime, Charlotte. Remember, you’re not alone in this.

p12/p12_conv_9:3.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_9:3.text: Mixed feelings? That sounds intriguing. Tell me more.

p12/p12_conv_9:4.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:4.text: I got recognition from a higher department for my work on this interdepartmental project.

p12/p12_conv_9:6.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:6.text: Thank you, but... I don't know, it's weird. I wasn't expecting it at all.

p12/p12_conv_9:7.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_9:7.text: I can see how unexpected recognition could feel a bit overwhelming. What’s making it feel weird for you?

p12/p12_conv_9:8.speaker: seeker
p12/p12_conv_9:8.text: I guess it’s because I’ve been under so much pressure and stress these past months.

p12/p12_conv_9:9.speaker: supporter
p12/p12_conv_9:9.text: That makes a lot of sense. You've really been through a lot at work with the workload and criticism. It’s natural to feel conflicted.

d0b12074bf71c35a280a6fc64a10d3f435cec3d8.head: MP
d0b12074bf71c35a280a6fc64a10d3f435cec3d8.statement: anxious about being publicly criticized at work after boss called out report errors in front of everyone

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Well, I found some errors in the project report I submitted, and my boss called me out in front of everyone. It was humiliating.

41dbc5c5aae8c1a38e3be58b181f8ca30aa2feb0.head: MP
41dbc5c5aae8c1a38e3be58b181f8ca30aa2feb0.statement: fears being perceived as underperforming and worries that all eyes are on her waiting for her to mess up

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: It's just hard when it feels like all eyes are on me, waiting for me to mess up.

ca82d7d70a4613130a2a9d654c21c0b82ec0166b.head: MP
ca82d7d70a4613130a2a9d654c21c0b82ec0166b.statement: experiencing ongoing disagreements at work, including feeling accused of not contributing enough to the team

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: We got into it because they felt I wasn't contributing enough to the team.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: It just hit me hard. I’ve been putting in extra hours and still feel like it’s never enough.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Exactly. And it's starting to take a toll on me, both physically and mentally.

7dd04434f8b1c136abc40bd8a47fa093f929bb2c.head: MP
7dd04434f8b1c136abc40bd8a47fa093f929bb2c.statement: anxious about being judged or fired after getting drunk at a staff appreciation event with coworkers and boss present

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Currently I am worried to show up to work. We had a staff appreciation Thursday and we all got super drunk in front of our boss, and I am honestly scared he will judge me or fire me.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Yes, we are all laughing at the matter, but you can tell our boss is looking at us different. We all showed up to work Friday hungover, and he just made lots of comments and jokes to play the part, but you can tell he is looking at me and everyone different. I do not know how to redeem myself.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: That sounds a lot easier said than done. I was the one who was the most drunk. But I do now know if he knows how drunk we all got since he left after one of us got hit in the face with a golf club and had to take her to the ER. So what if I say too much and apologize for what he does not know.

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: He is the doctor of the office and the 2 office managers were pretty drunk too. It was a hot mess if I have to be honest and being an office full of girls I feel like we went too far. I for one feel embarrassed, and feel like just not saying anything and it will fade away. But I know the next few weeks will be a little hard, for all of us. This one is for the books, and something I have never encountered in my 10 years of working.

3b9a19700e1ab9cce9c2e5d3f57a555a4d59e5c6.head: ME
3b9a19700e1ab9cce9c2e5d3f57a555a4d59e5c6.statement: had a disagreement with a coworker who accused her of not contributing enough to the team

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: We got into it because they felt I wasn't contributing enough to the team.

63829d55a3d03c436aa9eb47a7b9a7dc13841e87.head: ME
63829d55a3d03c436aa9eb47a7b9a7dc13841e87.statement: discussed breakup with friends who expressed sympathy but offered little practical help

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: It is still rather raw,I have mentioned to it to a few of my friends and they deeply symphatise with me but I feel there is nothing much they can do to help me.They are as shocked as me to be honest.

4d930db7c2a6bcc2796a3d2651dd3b5d0069a56b.head: ME
4d930db7c2a6bcc2796a3d2651dd3b5d0069a56b.statement: received empathetic listening and validation from supporter during conversation about work stress

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Thanks for listening. It means a lot to have someone to talk to who understands what I'm going through.

b7b63cf3b9b07a05a0f5e23319cddf23b14215e8.statement: shift in perceived relationship dynamic between seeker and boss following workplace social incident
